mods.name: Sensible AI Colonization
mods.author: Sadicto
mods.description: This mod improves how AI empires expand in the Space Stage. Instead of random or unrealistic expansion, empires now prioritize colonizing nearby star systems, especially those with habitable planets and valuable spice.
